steps.body: A double joins two equal groups: 4 + 4, 6 + 6, 8 + 8. Doubles are worth knowing by heart because so many other sums sit next to them.
steps.narration: A double joins two equal groups: 4 + 4, 6 + 6, 8 + 8. Doubles are worth knowing by heart because so many other sums sit next to them.

widget.prompt: Show the double 6 + 6: start at 6 and count on 6. Where do you land?
widget.missFeedback: Start at 6 and count on 6: you land on 12.
widget.successFeedback: Landed on 12 — six and six make twelve, a double worth remembering.

predict.prompt: 6 + 6 joins two equal groups. Will the total be even or odd?
predict.reveal: Two equal groups pair up perfectly, so a double is always even.
